note: Two paths. Slice 1 (S/C baseline) reads BASELINE/STOP: any S-vs-C head-of-line interference is a FIFO ADAPTER property, not HPX-native scheduling, and SUPPORT is unreachable by construction. Slice 2 (--with-parked) is SUPPORT-capable via the SYNTHETIC cooperative parked class Wp (park_ms): park_ms suspends the HPX task and frees the worker, so parked waits can overlap compute. overlap_ratio is approximate/structural and NEVER a gate; only the structural gates decide pass/fail. End-to-end includes the Ray actor boundary and is not a pure engine metric.

machine.node: Rostam / medusa06 (homogeneous many-core Linux; same node class as exp32/exp33)

structural_gates: PASS in every run (smoke baseline, smoke parked, full baseline run1, full parked run1/2/3)

smoke.note: Mac/laptop smoke clean-skips without Ray/_rayx; these are the Rostam smokes. Smoke is structural-only (low samples, per-class p99 = NA), not evidence.

full_baseline.interference_reading: FIFO-adapter head-of-line interference is real and largest at small W / coarse granularity, shrinking as W grows (more lanes/workers absorb the over-load). This is an ADAPTER property, not HPX-native scheduling; BASELINE/STOP correctly does not claim SUPPORT.

coarse_over_load_context.note: At coarse granularity the parked demand (Wp=5ms) is small relative to the heavy compute, so wall is compute-bound and overlap headroom is lower (W4_coarse_over ~0.96, parked demand roughly equals wall). Overlap is granularity- and W-dependent.

reading: On this homogeneous 40-core (2x20, 1 thread/core) Xeon node, under a SYNTHETIC parked-wait mix, the current Ray-hosted Runtime/lane adapter shows a fixed-W cooperative-overlap signal (median overlap_ratio >= 2.0 in all three runs; tightly reproducible fine over-load cells W8/fine/over ~4.45-4.48 and W16/fine/over ~7.61-7.65). The signal is granularity-sensitive: strong at fine granularity, weaker at coarse where compute dominates. The S/C baseline reads BASELINE/STOP and its over-load S-p90 inflation is a FIFO-ADAPTER head-of-line property, not HPX-native scheduling.
claims_allowed: Under a synthetic parked-wait mix, the current Ray-hosted Runtime/lane adapter shows a fixed-W cooperative-overlap signal on Rostam.
This does not evaluate HPX priority scheduling because priorities are out of scope.
claims_forbidden: treating FIFO-lane head-of-line blocking as an HPX-native scheduling property
park_ms_caveat: park_ms is a SYNTHETIC cooperative parked wait: it suspends the HPX task and frees the worker (cooperative, not an OS-thread sleep). It is NOT real I/O and NOT inference. overlap_ratio is approximate/structural and never a pass/fail gate; parked readings never assert wall-clock.
